title: Classic Canadian Beef Hash
description: A hearty breakfast dish made with tender beef and crispy hash browns. This recipe serves four and is perfect for a weekend morning.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef
ingredients.notes: 80/20 lean to fat ratio works best

ingredients.name: Hash Browns
ingredients.notes: Frozen hash browns or 2 large potatoes, peeled and grated

instructions: 1. In a large pan over medium-high heat, cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
2. Add the chopped onion to the pan and cook until translucent.
3. Add the hash browns to the pan and cook until golden brown, stirring occasionally.
4. In a separate bowl, beat the eggs and season with salt and pepper.
5. Add the eggs to the pan and scramble until cooked through.
6. Serve the beef and hash mixture hot, topped with the scrambled eggs.
7. Melt the butter on top and serve immediately.
